outcome.description: One natural-language statement: the result, how success is verified, what must not change, and when to ask a person.

teamId.description: The Team whose members the owner may hand work to; null when the owner works alone. Fixed at creation.

status.description: Only an operator's cancellation request sets cancelled; status updates cannot. limited means the budget or deadline was reached. completed and cancelled are terminal.

completionSummary.description: The completion assessment. While status is ready_for_review, the owner's assessment, which approval uses as the completion summary.

warnings.description: Returned only by creation. Conditions that would hold the Objective's turns, such as an owner Tag with no connected Worker Host. Creation still succeeds.

dryRun.description: Returned only by a dry-run creation, which validates and warns but stores nothing.

cancelledAt.description: When an operator cancelled the Objective.

cancellationReason.description: The operator's reason for cancelling, when one was given.

workspaces.description: Named Workspaces the Objective's work may use. With exactly one, work uses it by default; with several, the owner names one per work Session. An Objective created from a collaboration surface gets those of its Tag location, or a subset its creator names.

runtimeActions.description: Runtime actions, such as files:write, the Objective's turns may receive. Created without a list, it holds the actions the owner Tag's Permission Sets allowed at creation; a list only narrows that set. An Objective created from a collaboration surface gets the invoking Task's runtime actions. Later Permission Set changes do not rewrite it; operators replace it with an update.

budgetLimitMinor.description: Maximum organizational allocation in operator-defined minor units.

budgetCurrency.description: Optional uppercase three-letter denomination. With a currency, budgetLimitMinor also caps provider-reported cost across the Objective.

deadline.description: New turns stop at the deadline. Running Task Attempts keep authority for a 15-minute grace period. Operators may move it, including after it passed.

limitState.description: Control Plane observations of the budget and deadline: provider-reported spend, warnings raised, budget exhaustion, and deadline passage. Each entry names the limit it was observed against.

executionStartedAt.description: When the Objective's first turn was admitted; null until it starts.
